SELECT
    battle.name,
    battle.result,
    battle.bulgarian_commander
FROM
    battle
LEFT JOIN
    ship
    ON ship.lost_in_battle = battle.id
    AND ship.location = 'English Channel'
WHERE
    ship.id IS NULL;
